title: Extend the component description template
requirements:
- Add fields for accountable authority, operating model, prerequisites and dependencies, non-functional requirements and risks
- Identify the responsible actor for each requirement
- Specify intended use, audience and limits for material outputs such as alerts and scores
- Add conformance fields: test method, evidence, applicable profile, conditional applicability
- Add applicability (e.g. product class), standard, test method and evidence
- Classify requirements as universal baseline, conditional or advanced target state
